classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is a contemporary administrative record of a Nationalrat debate.
classification.resume: This is an audio recording of a debate in the Swiss National Council on June 19, 2006, concerning a parliamentary initiative by Josef Zisyadis to make a referendum on the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS) mandatory. The debate features speeches by Christophe Darbellay, Jean-Claude Rennwald, Ulrich Schlüer, and Josef Zisyadis.
